header: A complete design system for TYPO3 v14
subheadline: 244 content elements, 62 components and a theme layer, built on semantic tokens. You focus on the page.

feature_items.title: 244 ready-made elements
feature_items.description: Build pages from ten groups. Every layout stays consistent, with no custom templates.

feature_items.title: Theming that editors control
feature_items.description: Preset, dark mode, density, radius and fonts are site settings. A restyle takes one dropdown, not a deployment.

feature_items.title: Tailwind v4 pipeline
feature_items.description: OKLCH tokens and container queries compile to small static CSS. There is no runtime framework to ship or upgrade.

feature_items.title: A sound base for accessibility
feature_items.description: Shared semantic structure, keyboard patterns and WCAG 2.2 contrast checks give each component a good start. Check final pages with real content.

feature_items.title: Editing that stays on brand
feature_items.description: Backend previews, guided forms and inline editing in the Visual Editor keep every change visible and on brand.

feature_items.title: Quality you can verify
feature_items.description: PHPStan at level 8, PHPUnit and an automated template audit check the code and all 244 elements.
